document.title: Manu Ka Virodh Kyon Why Oppose Manu Hindi
document.author: Dr Vivek Arya

content.full_text: Manu Smriti Text is widely criticized by a group of persons. They claims that Manu supported Caste System and Manu was against Shudras. This is a Myth. In this small tract this doubt is clearly explained that Manu was not a supporter of Caste System. In middle ages interpolations were done in Manu Smriti which lead to this belief.
